full_text:
An unnamed pilot works for the Huntik Foundation and drives an old and somewhat unstable cargo jet. His job is to transport Seekers and Foundation vehicles to missions around the world.

History

The Foundation pilot was tasked with flying Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, Den Fears and Cherit to Baja California, Mexico where they would meet Dante Vale, along with a safari jeep and some motorbikes. The plane was attacked by Wilder's Suits near the airfield, but Lok and Den used two of the motorbikes to fend off the Suits. [The Power of Umbra]

Personality

The Pilot was shown to be quiet and focused on his job and did not appear to panic when the plane came under attack from the Organization. [The Power of Umbra]

Gallery

Image caption: Concept Art

Image caption: The pilot with Lok Lambert and Den Fears

Trivia

• Although the pilot is not named onscreen, he is referred to as Foundation pilot in his concept art.
• The back of his jacket pays homage to Las Vegas Lady, a 1975 American crime film.

The Foundation pilot was tasked with flying [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]], [[Den Fears]] and [[Cherit]] to [[Baja California, Mexico]] where they would meet [[Dante Vale]], along with a safari jeep and some motorbikes. The plane was attacked by [[Wilder]]'s [[Suits]] near the airfield, but Lok and Den used two of the [[Huntik Foundation's motorbikes|motorbikes]] to fend off the Suits. {{source|The Power of Umbra}}

== Personality ==
